grafana.description: Query Grafana dashboards, logs and metrics.
grafana.readOnly: The flag --disable-write removes the write tools.

argocd.description: Read the state of Argo CD applications.
argocd.readOnly: The variable MCP_READ_ONLY=true blocks changes to applications and resources.

kubernetes.description: Inspect Kubernetes resources with the current kubeconfig context.
kubernetes.readOnly: The flag --read-only blocks writes. The config file denies the Secret resource.

scaleway.description: Inspect Scaleway resources with the scw CLI profile.
scaleway.readOnly: The flag --read-only registers only get and list commands.

mcp-atlassian.description: Read Jira issues with a personal access token.
mcp-atlassian.readOnly: The variable READ_ONLY_MODE=true removes the write tools. The Claude deny rules in core stay active.

github.description: Read GitHub repositories, issues and pull requests through the hosted server.
github.readOnly: The header X-MCP-Readonly: true enables only the read tools.

sonarqube.description: Read SonarQube Server issues, quality gates and metrics.
sonarqube.readOnly: The variable SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY=true disables the write operations.

dbhub.description: Explore a database schema and run read-only SQL.
dbhub.readOnly: The config file sets readonly = true on the execute_sql tool. Use a read-only database role too.

playwright.description: Drive a browser from accessibility snapshots.
playwright.readOnly: Not applicable. The server controls a local browser and does not write to a remote system.

chrome-devtools.description: Inspect, profile and debug a Chrome page.
chrome-devtools.readOnly: Not applicable. The server controls a local browser. The flags turn off usage statistics and CrUX lookups.

figma.description: Read Figma designs and variables through the hosted server.
figma.readOnly: The deny rules block the tools that write to Figma files.

storybook.description: List components and docs from a running Storybook.
storybook.readOnly: Not applicable. The server reads the local Storybook. Start Storybook with the MCP addon first.

maestro.description: Run Maestro mobile UI flows on a device or simulator.
maestro.readOnly: Not applicable. The server drives a local device or simulator.

agent-device.description: Inspect and control mobile apps on iOS and Android devices.
agent-device.readOnly: Not applicable. The server drives a local device or simulator.

xcodebuildmcp.description: Build, run and test iOS and macOS apps with Xcode.
xcodebuildmcp.readOnly: Not applicable. The server runs local Xcode builds.

process-compose.description: Read the logs and state of the local stack when the host enables mcp_server in process-compose.yaml and keeps expose_control_tools off.
process-compose.readOnly: The control tools stay off while expose_control_tools is not set. The server reads logs and state only.

codebase-memory.description: Search a local code graph for symbols, callers and architecture.
codebase-memory.readOnly: Not applicable. The server indexes the project into a local database.

projectmem.readOnly: Not applicable. The server writes the project memory log in the project. Never log a secret.

context7.readOnly: Not applicable. The server only reads public documentation.

angular-cli.description: Angular CLI: documentation search, best practices and the workspace structure.
angular-cli.readOnly: The flag --read-only keeps the server to the read tools; no schematic runs.

typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official.description: Language server for TypeScript and JavaScript: types, definitions and diagnostics.

swift-lsp@claude-plugins-official.description: Language server for Swift: types, definitions and diagnostics.
swift-lsp@claude-plugins-official.install: install Xcode or the Swift toolchain (xcode-select --install)

kotlin-lsp@claude-plugins-official.description: Language server for Kotlin: types, definitions and diagnostics.

csharp-lsp@claude-plugins-official.description: Language server for C#: types, definitions and diagnostics.

rust-analyzer-lsp@claude-plugins-officia.description: Language server for Rust: types, definitions and diagnostics.

clangd-lsp@claude-plugins-official.description: Language server for C and C++: types, definitions and diagnostics.
clangd-lsp@claude-plugins-official.install: install clangd from LLVM (brew install llvm, or apt install clangd)

jdtls-lsp@claude-plugins-official.description: Language server for Java: types, definitions and diagnostics.
